name: useVideo
summary: Playing video back, with position, seeking and thumbnails.
plain: Plays a video file or stream. The natural partner to the camera: record a clip, hand the file to load(), and play it. It tracks position and duration so you can draw a scrubber, and can pull out frames as images for a poster or filmstrip.
description: Wraps expo-video, the SDK 57 replacement for the removed expo-av. The hook owns the player and a screen renders VideoView with it. Position, duration, buffered position and status are polled four times a second, which is enough for a scrubber without waking the JS thread every frame. Everything reported comes from the player rather than being tracked locally, so a seek made elsewhere still shows up.

params.name: initialSource
params.desc: Optional file URI, remote URL or bundled asset to load on mount. Defaults to null.

returns.name: player
returns.desc: Pass to <VideoView player={player} />. The view renders nothing without it.

returns.name: hasSource
returns.desc: Whether a source has been loaded.

returns.name: positionSeconds
returns.desc: Seconds into the clip. Drives a scrubber.

returns.name: durationSeconds
returns.desc: Total length. 0 until the source reports it.

returns.name: bufferedSeconds
returns.desc: How far ahead the player has buffered, which matters for a remote source.

returns.name: status
returns.desc: Player status, for example loading, readyToPlay or error.

returns.name: isLooping
returns.desc: Whether the clip restarts at the end.

returns.name: playbackRate
returns.desc: Speed multiplier; 1 is normal. Pitch is preserved.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: load(source, options?)
actions.type: (next: VideoSource, options?: { autoplay?: boolean; loop?: boolean; muted?: boolean }) => Promise<boolean>
actions.desc: Swaps the player source, for example the clip useCamera just recorded.

inputs.name: next
inputs.desc: A file URI, a remote URL, a required asset, or null to clear.

inputs.name: options.autoplay
inputs.desc: Start playing as soon as the source is ready.

inputs.name: options.loop
inputs.desc: Restart from the beginning at the end.

actions.output: Resolves true when the source was replaced, false with the reason in error otherwise.

actions.name: play() / pause() / togglePlay()
actions.desc: Transport controls for the player this hook owns.
actions.output: Returns nothing; isPlaying updates on the next poll or immediately, and error is set when the player refused.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.desc: Position in seconds, clamped to 0 and the clip duration.

actions.name: seekBy(seconds)
actions.desc: Moves relative to the current position.
actions.output: Returns nothing; on failure error is set.

actions.name: replay()
actions.desc: Restarts from the beginning and plays.

actions.name: setMuted(muted) / setLoop(loop)

inputs.name: value
inputs.desc: True mutes, or makes the clip restart at the end.

actions.output: Returns nothing; isMuted and isLooping reflect it. Muting does not change volume.

actions.name: setPlaybackRate(rate)
actions.desc: Sets playback speed with pitch preserved.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.desc: Clamped between 0.25 and 4; 1 is normal speed.

actions.output: Returns nothing; playbackRate reflects the clamped value.

actions.name: setVolume(value)
actions.desc: Sets player volume, independently of mute.

inputs.name: keep
inputs.desc: True while a video is playing; release it afterwards.

actions.name: generateThumbnails(times)
actions.desc: Extracts frames as images, for a filmstrip or a poster.

inputs.name: times
inputs.desc: One position in seconds, or several.

actions.output: Resolves with the extracted frames, or an empty array on failure with the reason in error.

agentNote: The view needs the player object; passing a URI to VideoView does nothing. Turn keepScreenOn off when playback ends or the screen stays lit.
